extensions.platform: android (Jetpack Compose + Material 3); dp/sp values, CSS snippets are approximations for the panel

display.purpose: Defined (34–48sp SemiBold) but unused by current screens.

headline.purpose: Entry title in the detail header.

title-large.purpose: Top-bar titles and the generator sheet title.

body-medium.purpose: Secondary lines, form messages, empty-state body.

label-medium.purpose: Field labels inside plates; navigation labels.

secret-large.purpose: Generated password in the generator plate.

secret-medium.purpose: Revealed secrets, password fields in clear, length readout.

shadows.name: fab-default
shadows.purpose: The only cast shadow in the app (plus Material snackbars/dialogs); plates and rows are tonal, never shadowed.

motion.name: ease-emphasized-decelerate
motion.purpose: Arrivals: key-cap flight, shackle lift, tumbler roll, copy check, form messages opening.

motion.name: ease-emphasized-accelerate
motion.purpose: Departures and the snap of a shackle closing.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Changes in place: strength colours, verdict colour.

motion.name: duration-short
motion.purpose: BovedaMotion.SHORT: fades and small feedback.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: BovedaMotion.MEDIUM: copy check/label roll, verdict colour, status band, form message open.

motion.name: duration-long
motion.purpose: BovedaMotion.LONG: the ceiling; no motion runs longer.

motion.name: keycap-shared-element
motion.purpose: Key cap lifts off its list row and lands in the detail header (40dp → 60dp) and back; predictive Back scrubs it.

motion.name: shackle-unlock
motion.purpose: Padlock shackle lifts on unlock.

motion.name: shackle-lock
motion.value: 220ms delay + 240ms keyframes (accelerate to -0.12 over-seat at 150ms, then standard settle)
motion.purpose: Shackle snaps shut with a slight over-seat after the lock screen fades in, so the click is seen.

motion.name: rejection-swing
motion.value: spring(dampingRatio 0.32, stiffness 420), initial velocity 340°/s about the ring hole; shackle rattle 70ms up + 130ms down; Reject haptic
motion.purpose: Pendulum swing of the emblem when the master password is rejected.

motion.name: tumbler-roll
motion.value: 180ms window per character, stagger min(16ms, 160ms/length), linear clock with emphasized-decelerate per cell; total ≲340ms
motion.purpose: Secrets change like pin tumblers; unchanged characters stay; instant while dragging the length slider.

motion.name: copy-confirmation
motion.value: icon scale 0.4→1 + fade (250ms in / 100ms out), label rolls up by half height; Confirm haptic; hold 1.6s
motion.purpose: Copy acknowledgement under the thumb.

motion.name: strength-fill
motion.value: 200ms ease-standard per segment, 30ms stagger; rises left-to-right, drains right-to-left
motion.purpose: Strength meter fills in order so the direction of change reads at once.

motion.name: nav-bar-hide
motion.purpose: Navigation bar slides away for pushed screens on compact windows and back on return.

motion.name: section-fade-through
motion.value: fade in 210ms after 90ms + scale 0.96→1; fade out 90ms
motion.purpose: Switching between top-level sections.

motion.name: entry-shared-axis
motion.value: slide 1/8 width 260ms + fade 160ms after 60ms; exit fade 90ms
motion.purpose: Into and out of an entry.

motion.name: list-animate-item
motion.purpose: Rows reflow while searching.

motion.name: form-message
motion.value: expand 250ms decelerate + fade 250ms after 50ms; shrink 150ms accelerate + fade 100ms
motion.purpose: Errors and notices open their own line.

motion.name: placeholder-pulse
motion.purpose: Placeholder rows while the vault decrypts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion ≤ ~400ms, never blocks input, and collapses to cuts under the system setting.

narrative.overview:
Bóveda is a board of hanging keys. Every account is a key with an anodized aluminium cap and a stamped initial; the board is brushed steel, the frame around the top-level places is a graphite shell panel, and brass marks the one thing to press. Secrets are stamped in a mono drawn to keep 0 from O and l from 1, and they read back character by character in their own inks. The category default it rejects is the navy-and-neon shield app with a grey list and one blue accent.

Density is list density: 72dp rows separated by hairlines inset past the key cap, one column capped to a readable width on large windows, and a thumb-reach primary action at the bottom of the detail screen. Rank comes from weight in a tight type scale, not from size jumps or colour. Depth is tonal (raised white plates on a cool grey ground) rather than shadowed.

Motion is mechanical and short: things move the way their physical counterparts would (a key lifts off its hook, a padlock shackle lifts and clicks shut, pins roll in a tumbler, a rejected key swings on its ring). Nothing waits on an animation, and the system "Remove animations" setting turns every one into a cut.
keyCharacteristics: Cool brushed-steel ground (#F1F3F5 light, #101316 dark), never cream.
Graphite shell panel only on top-level places: top bar, docked search, navigation bar or rail.
Brass for the one primary action and the selected navigation item.
Eight anodized key-cap hues used only for account identity, derived from the label.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for all UI, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for every secret and measurement.
Tonal depth; plates are lighter than the ground in both themes.
Mechanical motion, all within about 400 ms, never blocking input.

rules.name: The Colour Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Each family of colour has one job. Key-cap hues mean "which account", brass means "press this", strength colours mean "how strong", error means "wrong". No cap hue appears on a control, and no action uses a cap hue. Secrets read back in their own inks (secretDigit, secretSymbol), never a cap hue and never the action brass.

rules.name: The Label-Derived Cap Rule
rules.body: A cap's hue comes from a hash of the trimmed, lowercased label modulo eight, so an account wears the same cap in the list row, in flight and in the detail header. Collisions among eight hues are expected and accepted. Do not add hues or pick by position to avoid them.

rules.name: The Shell Marks Places Rule
rules.body: Graphite is reserved for top-level destinations (Bóveda, Generador, Ajustes). Pushed screens (detail, editor) use a plain steel top bar, so the shell itself tells you where you are.

rules.name: The Wallpaper Opt-In Rule
rules.body: Material You colour is opt-in from Ajustes (Android 12+). When it is on, the shell maps to surfaceContainer and onSurface, shellField to surfaceContainerHighest, the indicator to secondaryContainer, and plates to surfaceContainerLowest (light) or surfaceContainer (dark). Key caps, secret inks and the strength scale keep their own values.

rules.name: The Rank by Weight Rule
rules.body: The scale is tight (about 1.15 per step). Hierarchy comes from SemiBold against Regular, not from size jumps or colour. Search matches are highlighted in Bold inside the row's own text, never with a colour.

rules.name: The Mono Is for Secrets Rule
rules.body: Every secret and every number someone compares character by character (passwords shown in clear, entropy bits, generator length) is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono. Prose and labels are never mono. A hidden secret is always ten dots ("••••••••••"), so it never reveals its length.

rules.name: The Raised Plate Rule
rules.body: A secret sits on a plate (plate colour, 20dp corners, hairline dividers between fields) that is lighter than the ground. Do not lift it with a shadow, and do not sink it into a darker well.

dos: **Do** keep each colour family to its job: caps for identity, brass for the one action and selection, strength colours for strength, error for errors.
**Do** derive a key cap's hue from its label and accept collisions among the eight hues.
**Do** set every secret and every compared number in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, with digits in secretDigit and symbols in secretSymbol.
**Do** rank by weight (SemiBold vs Regular) and highlight search matches in Bold.
**Do** put a secret on a plate lighter than the ground, with hairline dividers between fields.
**Do** pin the primary action within thumb reach at the bottom of the detail (56dp, full width up to 600dp).
**Do** keep graphite for top-level places and align expanded-window bar content to the column with ShellPanel.
**Do** keep motion mechanical, within about 400 ms, and never blocking input, and let "Remove animations" cut it.
**Do** show the crack time, not a pattern tip, at the top strength rating.
donts: **Don't** colour a secret's characters with a key-cap hue or the action brass.
**Don't** use a key-cap hue on a control, or brass for anything but the primary action and selection.
**Don't** warm the ground toward cream. The steel is cool grey in both themes.
**Don't** add a second accent or a blue-shield palette.
**Don't** lift plates or rows with shadows. Depth is tonal.
**Don't** reveal a hidden secret's length. The mask is always ten dots.
**Don't** make the user wait on an animation. Rolls and flights run while the screen is already usable.
